title: Where capture-era GLRT finds the missing timing starts
sample: 24 authenticated dual-receiver visits, including 16 missed targets and eight already matched controls
boundary: Saved CI16 through installed capture coarse and fractional stages, then an independently ranked start into wide GLRT
note: Nine targets first appeared in the 22-anchor fallback. The primary rank-one start recovered one of 16, compared with 14 using the archived start. The primary prefix added 1.18 s median host CPU per dual-receiver visit.
